chitchat: scans the horizon and blows two short notes on a whistle at nothing.
"Engine on the wind. Could be nothing. Could be dinner."
description: A wind-burned wastes lookout perched on the truck cab with a pair of cracked binoculars and a whistle, watching the horizon for engine noise.

bye.text: They turn back to the guns and the sky.

root.text: They keep one eye on the sky. "Unless you're here to help work the guns, you're in the way. Move."

name: a wastes lookout
